  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
ws AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.sales_line_id, w.dispatch_date, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'),
gross AS (SELECT sku, sum(net_amount) g FROM ws GROUP BY 1),
ret_all AS (SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) rr FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE fs.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1),
ret_web AS (SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) rr FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT g.sku, round(g.g,2) before_returns, round(g.g-COALESCE(rw.rr,0),2) net_web_booked, round(g.g-COALESCE(ra.rr,0),2) net_all_returns,
 rank() OVER (ORDER BY g.g DESC) r_gross, rank() OVER (ORDER BY g.g-COALESCE(rw.rr,0) DESC) r_netweb, rank() OVER (ORDER BY g.g-COALESCE(ra.rr,0) DESC) r_netall
FROM gross g LEFT JOIN ret_all ra USING(sku) LEFT JOIN ret_web rw USING(sku)
ORDER BY net_web_booked DESC LIMIT 14
